binary_findings: BanglaBERT consistently outperforms TF-IDF on all binary datasets.
FGM improves in-domain binary performance on Ben-Sarc and BanglaSarc3-binary.
FGM also improves calibration in the in-domain binary setting.
ternary_findings: Weighted/confusion-aware loss improves BanglaSarc3 ternary test Macro-F1 over plain BanglaBERT.
Non-Sarcastic remains the hardest ternary class.
cross_dataset_findings: Cross-dataset performance is much lower than in-dataset performance.
Ben-Sarc is the harder target domain.
FGM does not help the harder cross-dataset direction and may reduce transfer performance.
error_patterns_to_write: Look for praise-like surface forms hiding negative intent.
Look for neutral vs sarcastic ambiguity in short comments.
Look for domain/style mismatch across Ben-Sarc and BanglaSarc3.
